policy.text: Begin with the lab's registration: a traceable standard is mandatory for this program. If confirmed, the proposed calibration interval may span up to 365 days. Apply these requirements in the stated order. At the first unavailable value, refer the claim for review. Reject at the first known violation. Approve when both requirements are met. Cite this policy and the record for every check through the decisive check.

Examine the peak temperature on the storage report first. It may not exceed 50 tenths of a degree Celsius. Next require a storage authorization specifically for research stock. Apply these requirements in the stated order. At the first unavailable value, refer the claim for review. Reject at the first known violation. Approve when both requirements are met. Cite this policy and the record for every check through the decisive check.
